title: Quality Center
intro: Read-only canonical evidence. No score or implicit threshold.
forbidden: Access denied: platform capability quality.read is required.
unavailable: Quality evidence is unavailable. Try again later.
unconfigured: No quality source configured for this environment.
invalid: Run unavailable: missing, invalid or incompatible evidence. No reliable verdict.
canonical: Results recorded by the canonical evaluator; no recalculation on this page.
securityScope: A gate PASS does not mean zero findings. Unexecuted scans remain deferred.
noFindings: No findings in the available sources; this does not prove absent scans.
testFilter: Exact tag: criticality, route or component
testLimit: First 100 matching tests. Totals remain those of the complete suite.
coverageScope: Unit JS coverage; SQL/RLS assertions, integration and E2E are separate.
observed: Observed deltas only. Comparing a candidate does not accept it as a baseline.
incompatible: Comparison unavailable: incompatible environment or policy, or invalid evidence.
sourceMaps: Policy: no public browser source maps; client/server boundary and test/debug leakage checks are in build evidence.
latencyScope: Latencies only when measured: local loopback, sequential, warm, unauthenticated. No production promise.
manualScope: Historical manual evidence does not validate new journeys. Axe replaces neither VoiceOver nor TalkBack.
artifactAbsent: No controlled artifact link available. Digests remain available.
